title: REKAM JEJAK COP SELAMATKAN SATWA PASCA BANJIR TAPANULI SELATAN
summary: COP Centre for Orangutan Protection rescued and provided care to animals affected by a major flood in Tapanuli Selatan, Sumatra.

title: DUA PEKAN MENGIKUTI JEJAK EBONI, BAGUS, DAN RUBY
summary: Bagus, Ruby, and Eboni were released into the Busang forest following a long journey from Berau, and their activities were monitored by a Post Release Monitoring (PRM) team for two weeks.

title: 11 seized orangutans repatriated
summary: 11 Sumatran Orangutans were seized from illegal trade operations in Malaysia and Thailand and repatriated to Indonesia.

title: Aceh bust uncovers vast Indonesia-Thailand wildlife trafficking route
summary: Customs enforcers in Aceh intercepted a truck carrying an orangutan along with other wildlife destined for Thailand, revealing a significant smuggling network.

title: Action Plan to protect Great Apes finalized
summary: The article discusses the finalization of a Global Strategy for Great Apes Survival by GRASP, highlighting poaching and illegal trade as key threats to great apes, particularly mentioning orangutans being taken from the wild for pets or zoos.

title: Hunting a key factor in Orangutan’s decline
summary: Hunting appears to have been significantly underestimated as a key reason for the historical decline of Orangutans, with recent studies suggesting that more than 1,000 Orangutans are killed annually in Indonesian Borneo.

title: Indonesia busts grisly online trade in wildlife skulls
summary: Indonesian authorities shut down an online trade of wildlife skulls, seizing 94 items including primate skulls believed to belong to Orangutans, and detaining two people involved in selling these items overseas.

title: No respite for Southeast Asia’s Red Apes
summary: At least 161 live orangutans were seized from January 2013 to July 2023 in Indonesia, Malaysia, and Thailand due to illegal pet trade activities. More than half of the seized individuals were juveniles.

title: Orangutan, gibbons and other animals seized at Soekarno-Hatta International Airport
summary: Authorities at Soekarno-Hatta International Airport seized a sedated young orangutan along with other endangered animals intended for the pet trade.

title: Seized orangutans repatriated
summary: Two Sumatran Orangutans seized from a duffel bag in Malaysia were repatriated to Indonesia.

title: Thailand repatriates smuggled orangutans to Indonesia
summary: Thailand repatriated 14 smuggled orangutans to Indonesia after they were rescued from illegal trade and cared for by Thailand’s Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation (DNP) for five years.

title: “Where’s My Mama?”
summary: The Body Shop and TRAFFIC launched an awareness campaign called 'Where’s My Mama?' to highlight the impact of illegal wildlife trade on animals like orangutans, tigers, and bears.

title: An assessment of trade in gibbons and orang-utans in Sumatra, Indonesia
summary: The study documents illegal trade of Sumatran orangutans for the pet trade in Indonesia, with inadequate law enforcement exacerbating the problem.

title: Apes in Demand for zoo and wildlife attractions in Peninsular Malaysia and Thailand
summary: The report highlights concerns over the illegal trafficking of non-native apes, including orangutans, for zoos and wildlife attractions in Thailand due to inadequate legislation.
